The cell rather than the bare integer is the unit, because the padding is part of what the emitter renders and a token pinned to the digits alone cannot be followed by it: the form notation has no way to write "digits, then however many spaces the alignment needs". These are COLUMNS rather than prose, so the cells carry no family word of their own; the word is in the header.

line_classes.note: a fixed literal but for the selected tag (§6.0.1 block 1).
the tag column widens to the longest rendered tag name, so the padding is a placeholder; the two family names and the two-space gutters are literal and are what this class pins.

the counts are pinned to the `CountCell` token rather than left as free placeholders, which is what makes this class discriminate a table row from any other line — a form of nothing but free placeholders admits every line on the surface. TWO NOTATION LIMITS shaped this form and are recorded rather than worked around silently (kogaki#745): ADJACENT PLACEHOLDERS COLLAPSE — the matcher masks each `<...>` to its hole INDEX and then splits on digit RUNS, so `<a><b>` masks to `01`, parses as hole 1, and hole 0 is dropped with nothing reporting it; the tag name and its column padding are therefore ONE placeholder. And a pinned token CANNOT BE FOLLOWED BY PADDING, because the form has no way to write "digits, then however many spaces the alignment needs" — which is why the unit is the CELL and not the integer.

limits._why: OWNER-EDITABLE NUMBERS, in the carrier the grammar already lives in (kogaki#738 ruling 5, extended by owner amendment 2 of 2026-09-01). A second config file would be a second place for a number to drift from the surface that renders it, so no new carrier is minted: the runtime reads these exactly as it reads decidable_rules.subdivision_required_at_ten.threshold_members. THE HARNESS ENFORCES EVERY KEY MECHANICALLY — amendment 2 ruling 2's own words, 'refusals, never reliance on the LLM following them implicitly' — so a key declared here with no refusal reading it is a defect rather than a default.

subgroup_member_cap._why_asymmetric: Brief consumes a `tight` group WHOLE and cannot yet filter Strands, so an oversized tight group lands entirely in a consumer with no way to narrow it — the harder cap follows the consumer's inability rather than the label's seniority. `related` and `loose` are browse material a reader scans and selects from.
subgroup_member_cap._residual_is_not_here: `other` is NOT an affinity label and carries no entry in this map. It is the RESIDUAL, bounded by `max_residual_members` below — a different quantity with a different purpose, and giving it a row here would let a reader treat the residual as a fourth affinity.

limits._why_thesis_candidates: How many Thesis candidates the Full Report's §12.3 section carries (kogaki#760, owner ruling 2026-09-01 that this is configurable like the member caps). ENFORCED MECHANICALLY at the runtime, per this block's own `_why`: a supplied candidate list whose length is not this number REFUSES the render, naming both figures. It is not a maximum and not a default the emitter pads toward — the count is exact, because a section whose length varies run to run cannot be read as a fixed early image.
limits._why_min: A composed SubGroup under M is refused (amendment 1 ruling 3, M initial 3). TWO EXEMPTIONS, both stated rather than left to the code: the residual has no floor, because a residual shrinking toward zero is the outcome the whole design wants and a floor would refuse exactly the classifications that did best; and a SubGroup holding the WHOLE parent group is exempt (owner selection 2026-09-01), because M refuses a splinter and a SubGroup that divided nothing produced none. Without the second, a group under M has no conformant affinity classification at all and the residual becomes its only path, which would force the judge to assert an absence of affinity that may be false.
limits._why_residual_cap: `other` = unlimited is an ANTI-PATTERN (owner amendment 1, superseding the body's '`other` is unbounded'). Until the residual falls to N the harness refuses the classification and forces the creation of additional SubGroups, naming the remainder count against N. This is the share cap's replacement: the deleted `catch_all_share` bounded a bucket the ENGINE filled as a fraction of its parent; this bounds a bucket the JUDGE fills as an absolute count, which is what stops Lessons disappearing into a black-box residual.

expressible._restored_at_v15: kogaki#739. This entry sat in `not_expressible` from v13, under a reopen trigger it wrote for itself — "the first `cotag_screen` line class that carries a group's own member count again … at which point this entry moves back into `expressible` with its predicate restored". The trigger has FIRED: `group_heading_subdivided` carries `<LessonCount>` again on the owner ruling of 2026-09-01. The entry moves rather than being re-pointed, which is the same discipline the withdrawal obeyed — a rule aimed at a quantity the text no longer carries is a predicate that cannot fail, and re-pointing it at the sum of the SubGroup counts would have compared a quantity to itself.
expressible._the_pre_render_refusal_is_NOT_withdrawn: `cmdCotags` still refuses DOUBLE placement and UNDER-placement over the placement record, by name, before a screen is composed (SPEC.md §6.2 rule 1). The two carriers read different things and neither subsumes the other: the pre-render refusal reads the DATA and catches a member placed twice or left unplaced; this rule reads the TEXT and catches a renderer that drops or miscounts a `subgroup_heading` line on data that placed correctly. That second failure is exactly what the withdrawn entry's `what_the_siting_costs` named as uncovered, and it is what returns to cover.
expressible._the_re_executable_case: NONE AT THIS HEAD (kogaki#770). It was checks/check-terrain-composition.sh — a crafted `validateSurface` case whose SubGroup counts do not reach the parent's, asserted to fire under this rule id, plus the emitter-side control that a conformant subdivided screen still renders — and that member was REMOVED under the 2026-09-02 retention rule (0 catches over 120 exercised runs, 20.5 s local). The rule id is therefore in exactly the state this field's own last sentence names: restored to this category with nothing exercising it, the finding PR #757 round 1 made, one polarity over. Recorded as a stated absence rather than left pointing at a deleted file, because a present-tense existence claim about an exercised case is not a prose mention and the issue's leave-history-as-written clause does not reach it. Re-earning the case is a new registered member with its own admission economics.
expressible._removal_signal: the parent count leaving `group_heading_subdivided` again — the same event, read the other way, that put this entry in `not_expressible` at v13. Event-shaped and mechanically decidable from this file alone: no line class carrying a group's own member count means no side of the comparison, and the entry returns to `not_expressible` with its cost restated rather than being re-pointed.

expressible.rule: a `group_heading_flat` line whose LessonCount is >= 10 must be followed by at least one `subgroup_heading` line before the next group heading

not_expressible.rule: a SubGroup labelled `tight`, `related` or `loose` carries at most limits.subgroup_member_cap.<label> members, and at least limits.min_subgroup_members unless its members are the whole parent group; the residual `other` carries at most limits.max_residual_members and has no floor
not_expressible.why_not_expressible: The rendered text does not carry the two sides together. A `subgroup_heading` line carries the member count; the coherence label is on the SEPARATE `subgroup_coherence` line, so no single line class holds both, and the residual's total spans every `other` SubGroup in the group rather than sitting on one line at all. A rule keyed on `a subgroup_heading line whose coherence label is …` describes a line the grammar cannot produce.
not_expressible.carried_instead: Three refusals in the runtime, at J2_subdivision — over the label's cap, under M, and a residual over N — each naming the SubGroup and the limit it crossed (SPEC.md §8, kogaki#738 ruling 3 and owner amendments 1 and 2, 2026-09-01). They read `limits.subgroup_member_cap`, `limits.min_subgroup_members` and `limits.max_residual_members` directly.
not_expressible.what_the_siting_costs: The refusals read the DATA and never the TEXT, so a renderer that emits a conformant record's SubGroup with a wrong count on its own `subgroup_heading` line is invisible to them. What bounds that is now NARROWER THAN IT READS, and the narrowing is stated rather than left: `subgroup_members_sum_to_parent` left this section at v15 (kogaki#739) and constrains the SubGroup counts only in AGGREGATE — it catches a wrong count that moves the sum, and admits two wrong counts that cancel. The golden specimen bounds the rest, and at v15 it is still a screen with no subdivided group in it, so for THIS entry the specimen bounds the per-SubGroup count not at all. Stated here because the sibling entry's restoration reads, from outside, like coverage this entry gained.
not_expressible.reopen_trigger: the first `cotag_screen` line class that carries a SubGroup's member count and its coherence label TOGETHER — at which point the per-label cap becomes decidable over the text and this entry moves into `expressible` with a predicate and a crafted case
not_expressible._sited_here_deliberately: It was in `expressible` at PR #757 (kogaki#738), where `validateSurface` dispatches on `rule.id` and an id with no arm is silently skipped — so the rule was considered and dropped on every screen, which is the conformance-category-with-no-members shape this section's own header warns about. Moved rather than given an arm, because the predicate is not writable over the current line forms.

deferred_slot_full_report_allowlist.what_is_owed: A decision on whether full_report's three bare-placeholder body classes (`group_claim_body`, `subgroup_claim_body`, `member_gloss_body`) are constrained, so that `line_class_allowlist` becomes live on this surface -- or whether a SECTIONED allowlist is admitted instead, refusing only lines under a heading whose section declares a closed class set. The second shape would make the rule live for the neighborhood section without touching the claim bodies at all.
